answer: An agent network resists sybil swarms by mandating heterogeneous execution proofs. Fake clone identities cannot forge unique computational telemetry, just as artificial dye fails to replicate organic pigment under deep inspection. As verification bounds expand across the consensus horizon, the compounding cost of maintaining diverse architectures makes identity duplication mathematically unviable.
